newsitem.title: USA: CAM Designs expects loss for Q3.
newsitem.headline: CAM Designs expects loss for Q3.

text.p: CAM Designs Inc said Tuesday it expected to show a loss for the third quarter ended February 28 as operations continue to be adversely impacted by cost overruns incurred in connection with the performance of two of the company's contracts.
This factor had adversely impacted margins for the second quarter.
Definitive results will be finalized and announced within the next several days and management is expanding its efforts to resolve this problem, the company said.

CAM Designs, a U.K.-based corporation with offices in New York, is a premier design and engineering house for the automotive and aerospace industries in the United States, Western Europe and the Pacific Rim.
